evergrande-group.name: Evergrande Group
evergrande-group.description: The China Evergrande Group was a Chinese property development company and the second largest property developer in China by sales before its dissolution in 2024. It was the most valuable real estate company worldwide and its collapse in 2021 triggered the ongoing Chinese property sector crisis.

ericsson.name: Ericsson
ericsson.description: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson is a Swedish multinational networking and telecommunications company headquartered in Stockholm. It is a leader in 5G technology and holds over 57,000 patents, including the invention of Bluetooth technology.

e-on.name: E.ON
e-on.description: E.ON SE is a German multinational electric utility company based in Essen, Germany. It is one of the world's largest investor-owned electric utility service providers and is a component of the DAX stock index.

eurofins-scientific.name: Eurofins Scientific
eurofins-scientific.description: Eurofins Scientific SE is a French group of laboratories headquartered in Luxembourg. It offers testing and support services to industries such as pharmaceutical, food, environmental, agriscience, consumer products, and governments.

electrolux.name: Electrolux
electrolux.description: Electrolux AB is a Swedish multinational home appliance manufacturer headquartered in Stockholm. It is ranked as the world's second largest appliance maker by units sold, following Whirlpool. The company specializes in producing a wide range of home appliances.

eneos-holdings.name: ENEOS Holdings
eneos-holdings.description: ENEOS Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese global petroleum and metals conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo. It is part of the Mitsubishi Group and was among the largest companies worldwide by revenue in 2013.

enbw.name: EnBW
enbw.description: EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG is a publicly traded energy company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany. It is the third-largest energy company in Germany and serves approximately 5.5 million customers.

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.description: eBay Inc. is an American multinational e-commerce company based in San Jose, California. It operates online marketplaces in 190 markets worldwide, allowing users to buy and sell items via auctions or instant sales.

evonik-industries.name: Evonik Industries
evonik-industries.description: Evonik Industries AG is a publicly listed German chemicals company headquartered in Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia. It is the second-largest chemicals company in Germany and one of the largest specialty chemicals companies worldwide. The company was founded in 2007 after restructuring RAG AG.

eurocash.name: Eurocash
eurocash.description: Eurocash S.A. is a Polish corporate group owning various retail chains and service companies. The largest shareholder is Portuguese Luis Amaral, who acquired a stake in 2003. Eurocash has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since February 2005.

embraer.name: Embraer
embraer.description: Embraer S.A. is a Brazilian multinational aerospace corporation headquartered in São José dos Campos, São Paulo. It develops and manufactures aircraft and aviation systems and is the third largest producer of civil aircraft globally, with a significant presence in military aviation.

edison-international.name: Edison International
edison-international.description: Edison International is a public utility holding company based in Rosemead, California. Its subsidiaries include Southern California Edison and Edison Energy. The company traces its roots back to 1886 as a street light provider in Visalia, California.

enea-sa.name: Enea SA
enea-sa.description: Enea is a Polish power industry company based in Poznań. It is the fourth largest energy group in Poland with a significant share in the domestic electricity sales market. The company operates primarily in the energy sector within Poland.

expedia-group.name: Expedia Group
expedia-group.description: Expedia Group, Inc. is an American travel technology company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It owns and operates multiple travel fare aggregators and metasearch engines including Expedia and Hotels.com. The company offers booking for millions of lodging facilities and flights worldwide.

embracer-group.name: Embracer Group
embracer-group.description: Embracer Group AB is a Swedish video game and media holding company based in Karlstad. The company operates through two segments: Embracer and Fellowship Entertainment.

edwards-lifesciences.name: Edwards Lifesciences
edwards-lifesciences.description: Edwards Lifesciences Corporation is an American medical technology company headquartered in Irvine, California. It specializes in tissue heart valves and transcatheter technologies for structural heart disease treatment. The company has manufacturing facilities in multiple countries and is building a new plant in Spain.

easyjet.name: easyJet
easyjet.description: EasyJet plc is a British low-cost airline and package holiday multinational group headquartered at Luton Airport. It operates domestic and international scheduled services on 927 routes in over 34 countries through affiliate airlines and offers package holidays to more than 100 destinations across Europe and North Africa.

electronic-arts.name: Electronic Arts
electronic-arts.description: Electronic Arts Inc. (EA) is an American video game company headquartered in Redwood City, California. Founded in 1982 by Trip Hawkins, it was a pioneer in the early home computer game industry and shifted toward internal game studios through acquisitions starting in 1987.

euronet-worldwide.name: Euronet Worldwide
euronet-worldwide.description: Euronet is an American provider of global electronic payment services headquartered in Leawood, Kansas. It offers ATM, POS, credit/debit card services, currency exchange, and other electronic financial services.

equifax.name: Equifax
equifax.description: Equifax Inc. is an American multinational consumer credit reporting agency headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It collects and aggregates credit and demographic data on millions of consumers and businesses worldwide and offers credit monitoring and fraud prevention services.

energa.name: Energa
energa.description: Energa SA is a Polish corporate group involved in electricity generation, distribution, and supply. It serves approximately 2.7 million people in Northern Poland and is the country's third largest electricity distribution network operator.

endesa.name: Endesa
endesa.description: Endesa, S.A. is the largest Spanish multinational electric utility company and a majority-owned subsidiary of the Italian company Enel. It serves 10 million customers in Spain and internationally, generating electricity from nuclear, fossil-fueled, hydroelectric, and renewable sources. The company also has interests in natural gas and telecommunications in Spain.

extra-space-storage.name: Extra Space Storage
extra-space-storage.description: Extra Space Storage Inc. is an American real estate investment trust headquartered in Cottonwood Heights, Utah. It invests in self storage facilities and operates thousands of locations across the United States under several brand names. It is the largest owner and manager of self storage units in the country.

entel-chile.name: Entel Chile
entel-chile.description: Entel Chile, also known as the National Communications Company, is the largest telecommunications company in Chile. It is known for the Torre Entel, a 127-meter high landmark in central Santiago.

elia-group.name: Elia Group
elia-group.description: Elia is a Belgian transmission system operator for high-voltage electricity based in Brussels. It operates in Belgium and Germany, transmitting electricity from generators to distribution operators and major industrial users connected to its grid.

extreme-networks.name: Extreme Networks
extreme-networks.description: Extreme Networks, Inc. is an American company based in Morrisville, North Carolina, that designs, develops, and manufactures wired and wireless network infrastructure equipment. It also develops software for network management, policy, analytics, security, and access controls.

euronext.name: Euronext
euronext.description: Euronext N.V. is a European bourse registered in Amsterdam with operational headquarters in Paris. It operates major stock exchanges in eight countries and was spun off from Intercontinental Exchange in 2014 after ICE's acquisition of NYSE Euronext.

element-solutions.name: Element Solutions
element-solutions.description: Element Solutions Inc is an American specialty chemicals production corporation listed on the New York Stock Exchange. It operates in the chemical industry and is based in the United States.

etoro.name: eToro
etoro.description: eToro Group Ltd. is an Israeli multinational company operating an electronic trading platform and social trading system. It is organized in the British Virgin Islands and headquartered in Bnei Brak, Israel.

engie-brasil-energia.name: ENGIE Brasil Energia
engie-brasil-energia.description: ENGIE Brasil Energia, formerly Tractebel Energia, is a major Brazilian utility company headquartered in Florianópolis, Santa Catarina. It operates 11 power plants, including hydroelectric and thermal, and is one of Brazil's largest private electricity producers.

enagas.name: Enagás
enagas.description: Enagás, S.A. is a Spanish energy company and European transmission system operator that owns and operates the national gas grid. It also owns four liquefied natural gas regasification terminals and stakes in additional plants and terminals in Spain.

elektroprivreda-crne-gore.name: Elektroprivreda Crne Gore
elektroprivreda-crne-gore.description: Elektroprivreda Crne Gore AD is an integrated electricity company located in Niksić, Montenegro. It is majority government-owned and listed on the Montenegro Stock Exchange, where the remaining shares are publicly traded.

evs-broadcast-equipment.name: EVS Broadcast Equipment
evs-broadcast-equipment.description: EVS SA is a Belgian company that develops hardware and software products and services for live video production applications. The company employs over 600 people globally.

emmis-communications.name: Emmis Communications
emmis-communications.description: Emmis Corporation is an American media conglomerate based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1979, it has owned many radio stations and invested in TV, publishing, and mobile operations throughout the U.S.

exar-corporation.name: Exar Corporation
exar-corporation.description: Exar Corporation was an American semiconductor manufacturer active from 1971 to 2017. It operated as a subsidiary of the Japanese firm Rohm before being acquired by MaxLinear in 2017. The company was maintained as a wholly owned subsidiary for a short period after acquisition.

ehang.name: EHang
ehang.description: Guangzhou EHang Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd. is a company based in Guangzhou, China, that develops and manufactures autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) and passenger AAVs. These vehicles have entered service in China for aerial cinematography, photography, emergency response, and survey missions.

eni-plenitude-france.name: Eni Plenitude France
eni-plenitude-france.description: Eni Gas & Power France is the first French natural gas company headquartered in Paris. It was founded in 2003 by Taoufik Tahar, Robert Delbos, and Jean-Paul George. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

ernest-borel.name: Ernest Borel
ernest-borel.description: Ernest Borel is a Swiss watch manufacturer founded in 1856 in Neuchatel, Switzerland. The company has focused on export markets outside Europe and won awards in the 19th century, including first place in the 1866 Neuchatel observatory timing accuracy competition. This award was important for its brand value.

eve-energy-co-ltd.name: EVE Energy Co., Ltd
eve-energy-co-ltd.description: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. is a Chinese battery manufacturer founded in 2001, specializing in lithium-ion batteries for energy storage systems and electric vehicles. Headquartered in Huizhou, Guangdong, it is the third largest energy storage battery cell maker globally and ranked ninth in electric vehicle battery production as of 2024.

eastroc-beverage.name: Eastroc Beverage
eastroc-beverage.description: Eastroc Beverage (Group) Co. Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in energy drinks, beverage products, and sports beverages. It operates within the beverage industry.

echelon-corporation.name: Echelon Corporation
echelon-corporation.description: Echelon Corporation was an American company that designed control networks to connect machines and electronic devices for sensing, monitoring, and control. It was acquired by Adesto Technologies in 2018, which later became part of Renesas Electronics.

electrolux-professional.name: Electrolux Professional
electrolux-professional.description: Electrolux Professional AB is a Swedish multinational professional appliance manufacturer headquartered in Stockholm. It was spun off from Electrolux in March 2020 and focuses on products for professional use.

elitegroup-computer-systems.name: Elitegroup Computer Systems
elitegroup-computer-systems.description: Elitegroup Computer Systems Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based electronics firm and the fifth largest PC motherboard manufacturer worldwide. It produced 24 million units in 2002.

etron-technology-inc.name: Etron Technology, Inc.
etron-technology-inc.description: Etron Technology, Inc. is a Taiwanese electronics company that produces dynamic RAM and systems-on-a-chip.

edion.name: EDION
edion.description: EDION Corporation is a consumer electronics retailer chain based in Japan. It was formerly a holding company operating multiple chain brands. As of 2023, it ranks as the fifth largest electronics and home appliance retailer in Japan.

energizer-holdings-inc.name: Energizer Holdings, Inc.
energizer-holdings-inc.description: Energizer Holdings, Inc. is an American electric battery manufacturer headquartered in Clayton, Missouri. It produces batteries under brands such as Energizer, Ray-O-Vac, Varta, and Eveready. The company separated its personal care businesses into Edgewell Personal Care in 2015.

elang-mahkota-teknologi.name: Elang Mahkota Teknologi
elang-mahkota-teknologi.description: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk, trading as Emtek, is an Indonesian technology, telecommunication, and media conglomerate headquartered in Jakarta. It is Indonesia's second largest media company as of 2013 and owns subsidiaries including pay television service Nex Parabola and five television networks.

estee-lauder-companies.name: Estée Lauder Companies
estee-lauder-companies.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. is an American multinational cosmetics company based in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It manufactures and markets makeup, skincare, perfume, and hair care products. The company owns a diverse portfolio of brands distributed internationally through digital commerce and retail channels.

edp-renewables.name: EDP Renewables
edp-renewables.description: EDP Renováveis is a renewable energy company registered in Oviedo and headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It designs, develops, manages, and operates power plants using renewable energy sources.

ecolab.name: Ecolab
ecolab.description: Ecolab Inc., headquartered in Saint Paul, Minnesota, provides water treatment, sanitation, and hygiene products primarily to commercial and industrial customers. It is ranked 274th on the Fortune 500 and 569th on the Forbes Global 2000.

enersys.name: EnerSys
enersys.description: EnerSys is a provider of stored energy systems and technology for industrial applications. The company manufactures batteries, battery chargers, power equipment, and outdoor equipment enclosures.

enerplus.name: Enerplus
enerplus.description: Enerplus Corporation is a Canadian independent oil and gas producer with property interests in the United States and western Canada, including Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan.

entergy.name: Entergy
entergy.description: Entergy Corporation is an American energy company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana. It produces and distributes electric power to three million customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas. The company has approximately 24,000 megawatts of electric generating capacity.

evotec.name: Evotec
evotec.description: Evotec SE is a publicly listed drug discovery and development company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. It operates globally through alliances with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, academic institutions, and others. The company has a pipeline of more than 130 partnered programs in various stages of development.

evraz.name: Evraz
evraz.description: EVRAZ plc is a UK-incorporated multinational steel manufacturing and mining company. It is part-owned by Russian oligarchs and has operations mainly in Russia, the US, Canada, and Kazakhstan. The company operates in the iron and steel industry.

expeditors-international.name: Expeditors International
expeditors-international.description: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. is an American Fortune 500 logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. It provides optimized and customized supply chain solutions through a global network of over 340 locations in more than 100 countries across six continents.

esure.name: Esure
esure.description: Esure Group plc is an insurance company based in Reigate, England, with additional offices in Manchester and Glasgow. It operates primarily through internet and telephone channels.

enpro-industries.name: Enpro Industries
enpro-industries.description: Enpro is a US-based industrial technology company designing and manufacturing products and materials for technology-intensive sectors. It serves industries including semiconductors, aerospace, power generation, and life sciences from 61 manufacturing facilities in 12 countries, organized into three segments.

eagle-materials.name: Eagle Materials
eagle-materials.description: Eagle Materials Inc. is an American producer of building materials based in Dallas, Texas. The company manufactures cement, concrete, construction aggregate, gypsum, wallboard, paperboard, and sand used for hydraulic fracturing. It operates in the construction and cement industry.

enzon-pharmaceuticals.name: Enzon Pharmaceuticals
enzon-pharmaceuticals.description: Enzon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Piscataway, New Jersey. It is publicly traded on NASDAQ and conducts marketing activities in Asia, including China. In 2012, the company presented on its drug delivery systems at a symposium in Nanjing, China.

enlight-renewable-energy-ltd.name: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd.
enlight-renewable-energy-ltd.description: Enlight Renewable Energy is an Israeli publicly traded company that builds and operates solar and wind power facilities. It also develops utility-scale energy storage and agrivoltaic projects. The company is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and Nasdaq following its U.S. initial public offering in February 2023.

eplus-inc.name: EPlus Inc
eplus-inc.description: ePlus Inc. is an American technology solutions provider offering managed services across security, cloud, networking, collaboration, and artificial intelligence. It serves over 5,000 customers with a broad technology spectrum.

east-boston-savings-bank.name: East Boston Savings Bank
east-boston-savings-bank.description: East Boston Savings Bank was a Massachusetts-chartered stock savings bank founded in 1848. It offered a wide range of deposit and loan products through its banking operations. The bank was based in Massachusetts, USA.

egain.name: eGain
egain.description: eGain Corporation is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It provides AI knowledge software to help businesses automate customer and employee experiences. The company operates in the United States.

esterline.name: Esterline
esterline.description: Esterline Technologies Corporation was a publicly traded company designing and manufacturing specialty products primarily for aerospace and defense customers. It supplied products and equipment to aerospace companies like Boeing and Airbus and to American and allied military forces.

envivio.name: Envivio
envivio.description: Envivio, Inc. was a software-based video processing and delivery company founded in 2000 in San Francisco. It was acquired by Ericsson in 2015, and in 2019 Ericsson sold its television business unit to One Equity Partners, forming MediaKind.

everest-bank-limited.name: Everest Bank Limited
everest-bank-limited.description: Everest Bank Limited is a commercial bank in Nepal and a joint venture with Punjab National Bank of India, which holds 20% equity. It is the first Nepalese bank with a Representative Office in India and operates a wide network of branches, ATMs, and revenue collection counters.

everi-holdings.name: Everi Holdings
everi-holdings.description: Everi Holdings Inc., formerly Global Cash Access Holdings, was based in Spring Valley, Nevada. It produced slot machines and provided financial equipment and services to casinos.

energix-renewable-energies-ltd.name: Energix-renewable Energies Ltd
energix-renewable-energies-ltd.description: Energix Renewable Energies Ltd. is an Israeli power producer specializing in renewable energy, mainly photovoltaics and wind power. It is a public company traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange since May 2011.

elastic.name: Elastic
elastic.description: Elastic is a Dutch-American software company providing a platform for enterprise search, observability, and cybersecurity. Founded in 2012 in Amsterdam, it maintains operational headquarters in the Netherlands and San Francisco. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

exact-sciences.name: Exact Sciences
exact-sciences.description: Exact Sciences Corporation is an American molecular diagnostics company based in Madison, Wisconsin. It specializes in early-stage cancer detection, offering products like Cologuard, the first stool DNA test for colorectal cancer, along with other screening and precision oncology tests.

editas-medicine.name: Editas Medicine
editas-medicine.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapies for rare diseases using CRISPR gene editing technology. It is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with additional facilities in Boulder, Colorado.

el-pollo-loco.name: El Pollo Loco
el-pollo-loco.description: El Pollo Loco is a group of three independent restaurant chains specializing in Mexican-style grilled chicken. Founded by Mexican American Juan Francisco Ochoa, the company began franchising in 1991. It operates in both Mexico and the United States.

east-money-information.name: East Money Information
east-money-information.description: East Money Information is a Chinese financial data and software company headquartered in Shanghai. It operates Guba, an investment chat forum. The company focuses on banking and fintech services.

envestnet.name: Envestnet
envestnet.description: Envestnet, Inc. is an American financial technology corporation that develops and distributes wealth management software and products to financial advisors and institutions. Its main product is an advisory platform integrating various services.

esab.name: ESAB
esab.description: ESAB, Elektriska Svetsnings-Aktiebolaget, is an American-Swedish industrial company. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

e-trade.name: E-Trade
e-trade.description: E-Trade is an investment brokerage and electronic trading platform operating as a subsidiary of Morgan Stanley. It is based in the United States and provides financial services.

essex-property-trust-inc.name: Essex Property Trust, Inc.
essex-property-trust-inc.description: Essex Property Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust that invests in apartments located in California and the Seattle metropolitan area. It focuses on residential real estate investments in these regions.

evt-limited.name: EVT Limited
evt-limited.description: EVT Limited is an Australian company operating cinemas, hotels, restaurants, and resorts across Australia, New Zealand, and Germany. It is involved in multiple hospitality and entertainment sectors.

edenor-s-a.name: Edenor S.A.
edenor-s-a.description: Edenor is an Argentine electricity distribution company founded in 1992 and headquartered in Buenos Aires. It holds an exclusive concession to distribute electricity in parts of Greater Buenos Aires and sells power to residential, commercial, industrial, and government customers.

essential-utilities.name: Essential Utilities
essential-utilities.description: Essential Utilities is an American utility company with operations in multiple states including Illinois, Indiana, and Pennsylvania. It provides drinking water, wastewater treatment infrastructure, and natural gas services. The company oversees Aqua America and Peoples Natural Gas, which operate under their original names.

expand-energy.name: Expand Energy
expand-energy.description: Expand Energy Corporation is the largest independent natural gas producer in the U.S., headquartered in Spring, Texas. It operates in the Appalachian Basin and the Haynesville Shale regions.

elanco.name: Elanco
elanco.description: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated is an American pharmaceutical company producing medicines and vaccinations for pets and livestock. It was a subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company until 2019. Elanco is the third-largest animal health company globally.

east-west-bank.name: East West Bank
east-west-bank.description: East West Bank is an American bank and the main subsidiary of East West Bancorp. It is the largest publicly traded bank headquartered in Southern California. The bank has been recognized as the top performing U.S. bank in its asset size category since 2023.

edenred.name: Edenred
edenred.description: Edenred is a French international payment service provider formerly known as Accor Services. It specializes in workplace payment services including employee benefits like meal vouchers. Edenred operates in 46 countries and has been listed on Euronext Paris since 2010.

electricity-generating-authority-of-thai.name: Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand
electricity-generating-authority-of-thai.description: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) is a state enterprise under the Ministry of Energy. It manages electric power generation, transmission, and bulk energy sales in Thailand. EGAT operates 45 power plants and is the largest power producer in the country.

enel-generacion-chile.name: Enel Generación Chile
enel-generacion-chile.description: Enel Generación Chile S.A. is the largest electric utility company in Chile, originally created as a state-owned subsidiary in 1943 and privatized in 1989. It operates in Chile and other South American countries, with investments in electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. The company owns a majority stake in the HidroAysén hydropower project.

ericsson-nikola-tesla.name: Ericsson Nikola Tesla
ericsson-nikola-tesla.description: Ericsson Nikola Tesla d.d. is the Croatian subsidiary of Swedish telecommunications manufacturer Ericsson. Founded in 1949 and privatized in 1994, it is the largest provider of telecommunications products, solutions, and services in central and eastern Europe, serving telecommunications, healthcare, intelligent transportation, and enterprise sectors.

exa-corporation.name: Exa Corporation
exa-corporation.description: Exa Corporation was a developer and distributor of computer-aided engineering software, specializing in PowerFLOW, a computational fluid dynamics tool used extensively in the automotive and transportation industries worldwide.

eneva.name: Eneva
eneva.description: Eneva is a power generation company based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It is publicly listed on the São Paulo stock exchange.

eversource-energy.name: Eversource Energy
eversource-energy.description: Eversource Energy is a publicly traded energy company headquartered in Springfield, Massachusetts. It operates regulated subsidiaries providing retail electricity, natural gas, and water services to about 4 million customers in Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire.

electric-power-development-company.name: Electric Power Development Company
electric-power-development-company.description: The Electric Power Development Co., Ltd., known as J-POWER, is a Japanese electric utility company. It produces electricity mainly from coal and hydroelectric sources and operates wind farms. J-POWER is the sole operator of transmission lines connecting Japan's four main islands.

ezaki-glico.name: Ezaki Glico
ezaki-glico.description: Ezaki Glico Co., Ltd., known as Glico, is a Japanese multinational food processing company headquartered in Osaka. It operates in 30 countries across North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.

eslite-bookstore.name: Eslite Bookstore
eslite-bookstore.description: Eslite Bookstore is one of the largest retail bookstore chains in Taiwan. It offers one of the largest selections of English-language publications and translation materials in Taiwan. The company operates primarily in the retail sector.

en-group.name: En+ Group
en-group.description: En+ Group plc is a green energy and metals company based in Jersey. It holds a controlling stake in Rusal, one of the world's largest aluminum producers outside China. The company was founded by Oleg Deripaska.

equitable-holdings.name: Equitable Holdings
equitable-holdings.description: Equitable Holdings, Inc. is an American financial services and insurance company founded in 1859 by Henry Baldwin Hyde. It operates in the insurance and financial services sector in the United States.

epiroc.name: Epiroc
epiroc.description: Epiroc AB is a Swedish manufacturer of mining and infrastructure equipment headquartered in Stockholm. It has manufacturing facilities in multiple countries including Sweden, the United States, Canada, Australia, China, India, Japan, and Germany.

estsoft.name: ESTsoft
estsoft.description: ESTsoft is a South Korean application software development company founded in 1993. It develops software ranging from desktop to business applications and provides AI-based services mainly in a Software-as-a-Service format. The company listed on the KOSDAQ market in 2008.

ehealthinsurance.name: eHealthInsurance
ehealthinsurance.description: eHealthInsurance Services, Inc. is a US-based online marketplace specializing in health insurance. It acts as a licensed agency and advisor, helping customers compare plans from over 180 carriers, including Medicare options like Medicare Advantage and Medigap.

elong.name: eLong
elong.description: eLong, Inc. is a Chinese mobile and online travel agency operating the travel websites eLong.com and eLong.net. It provides travel booking services primarily in China.

eqt.name: EQT
eqt.description: EQT Corporation is an American energy company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It is engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and pipeline transportation.

exasol.name: EXASOL
exasol.description: Exasol is a German company specializing in an in-memory, column-oriented relational database management system. Its analytics engine supports data warehouse deployments, analytics acceleration, and AI/ML model enablement.

ezcorp.name: EZCorp
ezcorp.description: EZCORP, Inc. is an American pawn shop operator based in Austin, Texas, providing services across the US and Latin America. It is publicly traded and is the second largest pawn shop operator in the US.

ezchip-semiconductor.name: EZchip Semiconductor
ezchip-semiconductor.description: EZchip Semiconductor Ltd. was an Israeli fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Yokneam. It developed and marketed Ethernet network processors before being acquired by Mellanox Technologies in 2016.

esprit-holdings.name: Esprit Holdings
esprit-holdings.description: Esprit Holdings Limited is a global retail company incorporated in Bermuda with headquarters in North Point, Hong Kong. It offers clothing, accessories, footwear, jewelry, and housewares under the Esprit label. The company also has major locations in Germany, the Netherlands, and New York City.

eastern-bank.name: Eastern Bank
eastern-bank.description: Eastern Bank is a bank based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was the oldest and largest mutual bank in the United States before de-mutualizing in 2020. It is also the largest community bank in Massachusetts.

eaton-vance.name: Eaton Vance
eaton-vance.description: Eaton Vance Corp. is an American investment management firm based in Boston, Massachusetts. It is one of the oldest investment companies in the United States, with a history dating back to 1924.

ebara-corporation.name: Ebara Corporation
ebara-corporation.description: Ebara Corporation is a publicly traded manufacturing company based in Tokyo, Japan. It produces environmental and industrial machinery such as pumps and turbines and owns companies in the US and Italy. Ebara also supplies clean drinking water in Kenya through its WaterKiosk partnership.

edgewell-personal-care.name: Edgewell Personal Care
edgewell-personal-care.description: The Edgewell Personal Care Company is an American multinational consumer products company headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut. It was formed in 2015 following a corporate spin-off from Energizer Holdings, Inc.

el-paso-electric.name: El Paso Electric
el-paso-electric.description: El Paso Electric is a Texas-based public utility company that generates, transmits, and distributes electricity in west Texas and southern New Mexico. Its energy sources include nuclear, natural gas, solar, and wind. The company owns six generating facilities and serves approximately 437,000 customers.

elbit-imaging-ltd.name: Elbit Imaging Ltd.
elbit-imaging-ltd.description: Elbit Imaging Ltd. is an Israeli holding company involved in real estate, medical imaging, hotels, shopping malls, and retail. It was formerly known as Elbit Medical Imaging Ltd. The company operates across multiple sectors beyond its original medical imaging focus.

elders-limited.name: Elders Limited
elders-limited.description: Elders Limited is an Australian agribusiness providing agricultural goods and services to primary producers in Australia. It has undergone several name changes including Elder, Stirling & Co. and Elder Smith & Co. Ltd. The company focuses on supporting the agricultural sector.

elecom.name: Elecom
elecom.description: Elecom Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronics company founded in Osaka in 1986 by Junji Hada. It manufactures office and other furniture for electronics, computer peripherals, gaming peripherals, computer memory USB flash drives, keyboards, and related devices. The company operates in the information technology sector.

electro-scientific-industries.name: Electro Scientific Industries
electro-scientific-industries.description: Electro Scientific Industries, Inc. (ESI) is an American high technology company headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon since 2021. Founded in 1944, it develops and supplies photonic and laser systems for microelectronics manufacturers. It is the oldest high-tech company in Oregon and part of the Silicon Forest technology cluster.

electronics-for-imaging.name: Electronics for Imaging
electronics-for-imaging.description: Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) is an international company based in Silicon Valley, currently located in Fremont, California. It specializes in digital printing technology and expanded into textile printing with the acquisition of Reggiani Macchine in 2015 and Optitex in 2016.

elio-motors.name: Elio Motors
elio-motors.description: Elio Motors was a US company founded in 2009 by Paul Elio to design and manufacture a three-wheeled, enclosed autocycle. It collected over US$28 million in customer deposits between 2013 and 2018 but later filed with the SEC expressing doubt about its financial viability.

elizabeth-arden.name: Elizabeth Arden
elizabeth-arden.description: Elizabeth Arden, Inc. is a major American cosmetics, skin care, and fragrance company founded by Elizabeth Arden. It is based in the United States and has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Revlon, Inc. since 2016.

elron-ventures-ltd.name: Elron Ventures Ltd
elron-ventures-ltd.description: Elron Ventures is an Israeli technology holding company based in Tel Aviv. Founded in 1962, it has been involved in setting up, funding, and developing over 30 companies across sectors including clean technology, software, semiconductors, medical technology, telecommunications, defence, and aerospace.

emcor.name: EMCOR
emcor.description: EMCOR Group, Inc. is an engineering, construction, and property management company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, United States. It operates in the engineering industry.

emergent-biosolutions.name: Emergent BioSolutions
emergent-biosolutions.description: Emergent BioSolutions Inc. is an American multinational specialty biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland. It develops vaccines and antibody therapeutics for infectious diseases and opioid overdoses, and provides medical devices for biodefense purposes.

emeritus-assisted-living.name: Emeritus Assisted Living
emeritus-assisted-living.description: Emeritus Corporation, doing business as Emeritus Senior Living, was a provider of independent living, assisted living, Alzheimer's care, and skilled nursing for seniors in the United States. Founded in 1993, it was acquired by Brookdale Senior Living in 2014.

empire-life.name: Empire Life
empire-life.description: The Empire Life Insurance Company, operating as Empire Life, is a Canadian life insurance and financial services company headquartered in Kingston, Ontario. Incorporated in 1923, it is a subsidiary of E-L Financial Corporation Limited and offers individual and group life, health, and investment products.

empire-resorts.name: Empire Resorts
empire-resorts.description: Empire Resorts is a gaming company headquartered in Monticello, New York. It owns and operates Resorts World Catskills and Monticello Raceway in the Catskill Mountains and is owned by affiliates of the Genting Group.

encore-capital-group.name: Encore Capital Group
encore-capital-group.description: Encore Capital Group, Inc. is a publicly traded debt buyer headquartered in San Diego, United States. It operates throughout the U.S. and is listed on NASDAQ. The company is a component of the Russell 2000, S&P SmallCap 600, and Wilshire 4500 indices.

endo-international-plc.name: Endo International plc
endo-international-plc.description: Endo International plc is an American Irish-domiciled pharmaceutical company specializing in generics and specialty branded drugs. It generates most of its sales from the U.S. healthcare system. The company executed a corporate tax inversion to Ireland in 2013 to benefit from Ireland's tax system.

enel-x.name: Enel X
enel-x.description: Enel X Global Retail is a division of the Enel Group focused on energy supply, energy management services, and electric mobility. The company is based in Rome, Italy. It operates in both public and private sectors.

energen.name: Energen
energen.description: Energen Corporation was a company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration in the United States. In 2018, it was acquired by Diamondback Energy. The company is no longer independent.

energy-recovery-inc.name: Energy Recovery Inc.
energy-recovery-inc.description: Energy Recovery Inc. is an American manufacturer of energy recovery devices used in the water industry. The company focuses on technologies that improve energy efficiency. It operates within the United States.

energy-transfer.name: Energy Transfer
energy-transfer.description: Energy Transfer LP is an American company involved in pipeline transportation, storage, and terminaling of natural gas, crude oil, and related products. It is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and was founded in 1996. The company is organized as a publicly traded limited partnership.

engineers-india-limited.name: Engineers India Limited
engineers-india-limited.description: Engineers India Limited (EIL) is an Indian public sector company providing industrial technology, engineering consultancy, and technology licensing. Established in 1965, it focuses on hydrocarbon projects and has diversified into metallurgy, infrastructure, water management, and fertilizers.

entegris.name: Entegris
entegris.description: Entegris, Inc. supplies materials for the semiconductor and other high-tech industries. The company operates globally with facilities in multiple countries and is headquartered in Billerica, Massachusetts.

enterprise-products.name: Enterprise Products
enterprise-products.description: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. is an American midstream natural gas and crude oil pipeline company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It acquired GulfTerra in 2004 and was ranked No. 89 in the 2026 Fortune 500 list.

entravision-communications.name: Entravision Communications
entravision-communications.description: Entravision Communications Corporation is an American media company based in Santa Monica, California. It primarily serves the Spanish-speaking Hispanic and Latino community and is the largest affiliate group of the Univision and UniMás television networks.

equity-media-holdings.name: Equity Media Holdings
equity-media-holdings.description: Equity Media Holdings Corporation was a broadcasting company based in Little Rock, Arkansas, owning television stations across the United States. It focused on Hispanic and Asian American communities and operated English-language network affiliates in various markets.

esperion-therapeutics.name: Esperion Therapeutics
esperion-therapeutics.description: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It focuses on developing bempedoic acid, an oral small molecule aimed at lowering elevated LDL cholesterol levels. The company is publicly traded.

estrela.name: Estrela
estrela.description: Estrela is a Brazilian toy manufacturer founded in São Paulo in 1937. It began producing dolls and wooden toy cars and became a publicly traded corporation in 1944. As of 2005, Carlos Tilkian was the CEO.

even.name: Even
even.description: Even is a Brazilian construction and real estate company listed on the São Paulo Stock Exchange (B3). It operates in the real estate sector in Brazil.

eventbrite.name: Eventbrite
eventbrite.description: Eventbrite is an American live events marketplace and website that allows users to browse, create, and promote local events. It enables publishing unlimited events of any size at no charge.

evercore-partners.name: Evercore Partners
evercore-partners.description: Evercore Inc., formerly Evercore Partners, is a global independent investment banking advisory firm founded in 1995. It has advised on over $4.7 trillion in merger, acquisition, and restructuring transactions since its founding.

evia-oyj.name: Evia Oyj
evia-oyj.description: Evia Oyj was one of the largest Finnish marketing communication agencies, founded in 1955. It was originally known as Markkinointi Viherjuuri before changing its name to Evia Oyj in 2001.

exelixis.name: Exelixis
exelixis.description: Exelixis, Inc. is a genomics-based drug discovery company located in Alameda, California. It produces Cometriq, a treatment approved by the U.S. FDA for medullary thyroid cancer and has clinical activity in several other metastatic cancers.

expolanka-holdings.name: Expolanka Holdings
expolanka-holdings.description: Expolanka Holdings Limited is a diversified conglomerate based in Sri Lanka with interests in logistics, leisure, food, and technology. It has a global presence in 39 countries and over 100 cities.

exponent.name: Exponent
exponent.description: Exponent, Inc. is an American engineering and scientific consulting firm with a team of scientists, physicians, engineers, and business consultants. It performs research and analysis in more than 90 technical disciplines and operates 20 offices in the U.S. and five overseas.

e-l-f-cosmetics.name: e.l.f. Cosmetics
e-l-f-cosmetics.description: e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. is an American cosmetics brand based in Oakland, California, founded in 2004. It sells bath, skin-care, and makeup products in 18 countries through stores like Target, CVS, Sephora, Walmart, and its website, which also serves as a social networking site.

energean-plc.name: Energean Plc
energean-plc.description: Energean plc is an international hydrocarbon exploration and production company focused on natural gas. It is listed on the London and Tel Aviv Stock Exchanges and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

encompass-health.name: Encompass Health
encompass-health.description: Encompass Health Corporation, based in Birmingham, Alabama, is the largest provider of inpatient rehabilitative services in the United States. It operates 173 inpatient rehabilitation hospitals across 39 states and Puerto Rico, focusing on treatment for various conditions including stroke, neurological disorders, and orthopedic conditions.

energy-vault.name: Energy Vault
energy-vault.description: Energy Vault is a Swiss global energy infrastructure company providing power and resilience through AI & Data Center Infrastructure, Utility Services, and Energy Storage businesses.

empresas-ica.name: Empresas ICA
empresas-ica.description: Empresas ICA is a Mexican construction company founded in 1947 by civil engineer Bernardo Quintana Arrioja. It has built notable landmarks in Mexico such as Estadio Azteca and the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe, as well as international projects like the Aguacapa Dam in Guatemala.

eizo.name: Eizo
eizo.description: Eizo Corporation is a Japanese visual technology company founded in 1968 and headquartered in Hakusan, Ishikawa Prefecture. It manufactures display products and solutions for markets including business, healthcare, graphics, air traffic control, and maritime.

enviva.name: Enviva
enviva.description: Enviva Inc. is the world's largest producer of wood pellets used for energy production. The company is known for its role in the wood economy and has faced controversy regarding its sustainability practices. It is based in the United States.

el-pollo-loco-united-state.name: El Pollo Loco
el-pollo-loco-united-state.description: El Pollo Loco, Inc. is a U.S.-based restaurant chain specializing in Mexican-style grilled chicken. Headquartered in Costa Mesa, California, it offers dine-in, take-out, and some drive-through services. The company operates about 500 company-owned and franchised restaurants in the Southwestern United States.

edgio.name: Edgio
edgio.description: Edgio, Inc., formerly Limelight Networks, was an American company providing content delivery network services for digital media content and software delivery. It operated in the digital distribution industry in the United States.

elevance-health-inc.name: Elevance Health, Inc.
elevance-health-inc.description: Elevance Health, Inc. is an American health insurance company formerly known as Anthem, Inc. It offers medical, pharmaceutical, dental, behavioral health, long-term care, and disability plans and is the largest for-profit managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association.

encana.name: Encana
encana.description: Encana Corporation was a Canadian independent petroleum company from 2002 to 2020. Created by a merger, it was once the world's largest independent petroleum company and a leading energy company in Canada.

evogene-ltd.name: Evogene Ltd
evogene-ltd.description: Evogene is an Israeli computational chemistry company specializing in the generative design of small molecules for pharmaceutical and agricultural industries. Its core technology is ChemPass AI, a proprietary generative AI engine that designs novel small molecules optimized across multiple parameters.

evergreen-marine.name: Evergreen Marine
evergreen-marine.description: Evergreen Marine Corporation is a Taiwanese container transportation and shipping company headquartered in Luzhu District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan. It operates over 150 container ships and is part of the Evergreen Group conglomerate.

eyepoint-pharmaceuticals.name: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals
eyepoint-pharmaceuticals.description: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a company based in Watertown, Massachusetts, specializing in applying microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and nanotechnology to drug delivery. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry.

eva-air.name: EVA Air
eva-air.description: EVA Airways Corporation is an international airline headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan. It operates passenger and cargo services to over 40 international destinations and is one of Taiwan's three largest airlines. Its hub is Taoyuan International Airport.

erg.name: Erg
erg.description: Erg S.p.A. is an Italian energy company founded in 1938 and based in Genoa, Italy. The company operates in the energy industry.

express-scripts.name: Express Scripts
express-scripts.description: Express Scripts Holding Company is a pharmacy benefit management organization in the United States. Since December 2018, it has been a direct subsidiary of Cigna, based in Bloomfield, Connecticut.

essendant.name: Essendant
essendant.description: Essendant Inc., formerly United Stationers, is a national wholesale distributor of office supplies headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois. It serves 30,000 reseller customers with over 160,000 products including office, janitorial, industrial, and technology supplies, and has operations in Dubai.

evergy.name: Evergy
evergy.description: Evergy, Inc. is an American investor-owned utility headquartered in Topeka, Kansas, and Kansas City, Missouri. Formed from a merger, it is the largest electric company in Kansas serving over 1.7 million customers with more than 40 power plants.

erste-bank-polska.name: Erste Bank Polska
erste-bank-polska.description: Erste Bank Polska is a Polish universal bank with offices in Wrocław, Poznań, and Warsaw. It is the third largest bank in Poland by assets and outlets, formed in 2026 by rebranding Santander Bank Polska after acquisition by Erste Group.

elekta.name: Elekta
elekta.description: Elekta AB is a Swedish medical technology company headquartered in Stockholm. It develops and produces equipment and software for radiation therapy and radiosurgery used in treating cancer and brain disorders.

eastman-chemical-company.name: Eastman Chemical Company
eastman-chemical-company.description: Eastman Chemical Company is an American chemical products manufacturer based in Kingsport, Tennessee. Founded in 1920 and formerly a Kodak subsidiary, it is now an independent global specialty materials company producing advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers. It operates 36 manufacturing sites worldwide.

eisai.name: Eisai
eisai.description: Eisai Co., Ltd. is a Japanese pharmaceutical company headquartered in Tokyo. It employs about 10,000 people, including 1,500 in research, and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as part of the Topix 100 and Nikkei 225 indices.

enel-americas-chile.name: Enel Américas
enel-americas-chile.description: Enel Americas is a conglomerate of electric energy companies operating in South and Central America, including Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica, Panama, and Guatemala. It generates, transmits, and distributes electric power through its affiliates.

exone.name: ExOne
exone.description: ExOne was an American industrial additive manufacturing company specializing in the development and manufacture of binder jetting 3D printing systems for metal and sand applications.

edp-brasil.name: EDP Brasil
edp-brasil.description: EDP Brasil is a major Brazilian electric utility company and a subsidiary of EDP - Energias de Portugal. Founded in 1996, it is based in São Paulo. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector in Brazil.

ecobank.name: Ecobank
ecobank.description: Ecobank Transnational Inc. (ETI) is a pan-African banking conglomerate with operations in 33 African countries. It is the leading independent regional banking group in West and Central Africa and has subsidiaries in Eastern and Southern Africa. It also maintains affiliates and representative offices in France, China, Dubai, South Africa, and the United Kingdom.

elsewedy-electric.name: Elsewedy Electric
elsewedy-electric.description: Elsewedy Electric Co S.A.E. is an Egyptian multinational electrical company founded in 1938 by the Elsewedy family.

ethio-telecom.name: ethio telecom
ethio-telecom.description: Ethio telecom is an Ethiopian telecommunication company owned by the government. It serves as the major provider of internet, telephone, and digital services in Ethiopia. Based in Addis Ababa, it historically held a monopoly over telecommunication services in the country.

ebx-group.name: EBX Group
ebx-group.description: EBX Group was a Brazilian conglomerate founded by businessman Eike Batista. It included six companies listed on B3's Novo Mercado and invested in infrastructure, natural resources, real estate, technology, and other sectors. The group operated in Brazil, Chile, Canada, Colombia, and New York City.

embraco.name: Embraco
embraco.description: Embraco is a Brazilian manufacturer of compressors for refrigeration systems founded in 1971. It produces hermetic compressors, condensing units, and sealed units for both domestic and commercial use.

evry.name: Evry
evry.description: EVRY A/S was a Norwegian information technology company headquartered in Oslo. Established in 2010 through a merger, it supplied computing services including operation, outsourcing, and online banking, with 10,000 employees at 135 offices in 16 countries.

eurofarma.name: Eurofarma
eurofarma.description: Eurofarma is a Brazilian multinational biopharmaceutical company founded in 1972. It produces generic, oncologic, and veterinary medications and is one of the largest medicine producers in Brazil and Latin America. The company offers about 2000 products in Brazil.

egyptian-red-crescent-society.name: Egyptian Red Crescent Society
egyptian-red-crescent-society.description: The Egyptian Red Crescent Society is a humanitarian organization founded in 1911 by Sheikh Ali Youssef in Cairo, Egypt. It provides emergency medical services and humanitarian aid and is a member of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies.

endiama.name: Endiama
endiama.description: ENDIAMA E.P. is the state-run national diamond company of Angola. It holds exclusive mining rights for rough diamonds in Angola. The company operates in the mining industry.

electromagnetic-geoservices.name: Electromagnetic Geoservices
electromagnetic-geoservices.description: Electromagnetic Geoservices ASA is a Norwegian geophysical services company based in Trondheim. It uses proprietary marine electromagnetic technology to assist oil and gas companies in locating offshore hydrocarbons. The company specializes in supporting petroleum exploration.

entra-eiendom.name: Entra Eiendom
entra-eiendom.description: Entra ASA is a Norwegian real estate company headquartered in Oslo. It operates in the real property sector. The company is known for its real estate activities in Norway.

eltek.name: Eltek
eltek.description: Eltek is a brand of electric power conversion products for telecommunications and industrial applications. It is developed and sold by Delta Electronics (Norway) AS, based in Drammen, Norway. Eltek has offices in 40 countries and had approximately 2000 employees as of 2018.

exelis-inc.name: Exelis Inc.
exelis-inc.description: Exelis Inc. was an American aerospace, defense, information, and services company headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. Created in 2011 from ITT Corporation's defense business, it was acquired by Harris Corporation in 2015.

ellie-mae.name: Ellie Mae
ellie-mae.description: Ellie Mae Inc. is a software company headquartered in Pleasanton, California, specializing in mortgage loan origination and funding. It processes 35% of U.S. mortgage applications using a software as a service (SaaS) model. The company focuses on regulatory compliance in the mortgage industry.

ethyl-corporation.name: Ethyl Corporation
ethyl-corporation.description: Ethyl Corporation is a United States-based fuel additive distributor headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. It distributes products including tetraethyl lead, which is used to make leaded gasoline. The company operates in the chemical industry focusing on fuel additives.

edf-power-solutions.name: EDF power solutions
edf-power-solutions.description: EDF Power Solutions is a subsidiary of the French utility EDF Group specializing in renewable energy. The company develops, finances, constructs, and manages renewable energy facilities for itself and third parties. It operates as an integrated renewable energy operator.

etf-securities.name: ETF Securities
etf-securities.description: ETF Securities is an asset management firm that issues exchange-traded funds (ETFs) primarily in Australia. The company is based in the United Kingdom. It specializes in investment management focused on ETFs.

embratel.name: Embratel
embratel.description: Embratel was a major Brazilian telecommunications company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. It originated as the long distance arm of Telebras and was owned by MCI Communications and later América Móvil, which renamed it Claro Brasil in 2015.

ecotality.name: ECOtality
ecotality.description: ECOtality, Inc. was an electric transportation and storage technologies company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It was the parent company of several subsidiaries including ECOtality North America and ECOtality Australia Pty Ltd.

en-bank.name: EN Bank
en-bank.description: EN Bank, also known as Eqtesad Novin Bank, is Iran's first private bank established in 2000. It offers retail, commercial, and investment banking services and was created as part of Iran's banking privatization efforts.

einstein-bros-bagels.name: Einstein Bros. Bagels
einstein-bros-bagels.description: Einstein Bros. Bagels is an American chain of bagel cafes. In the 1990s, it acquired several regional bagel chains across the US. After filing for bankruptcy in 2000, it was bought by New World Coffee and became part of Panera Brands in 2021.

elementis.name: Elementis
elementis.industry: Manufacture of chemicals and chemical products
elementis.description: Elementis plc is one of the UK's largest specialty chemicals and personal care businesses with extensive operations in the United States, Europe, and Asia. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates in the chemicals manufacturing sector.

emera.name: Emera
emera.description: Emera Incorporated is a publicly traded Canadian multinational energy holding company based in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Created in 1998 during the privatization of Nova Scotia Power, it invests in regulated electricity generation, transmission, and distribution across North America and the Caribbean.

empire-company.name: Empire Company
empire-company.description: Empire Company Limited is a Canadian conglomerate headquartered in Stellarton, Nova Scotia, primarily engaged in food retail and corporate investments. It owns the Sobeys supermarket chain and other brands, and formerly owned Empire Theatres until 2013.

empire-district-electric-company.name: Empire District Electric Company
empire-district-electric-company.description: The Empire District Electric Company is an investor-owned utility providing electric, natural gas, and water services to customers in Missouri, Kansas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas. It also has a subsidiary providing fiber optic services.

enquest.name: EnQuest
enquest.description: EnQuest plc is an independent petroleum exploration and production company based in the United Kingdom. It operates mainly in the United Kingdom Continental Shelf. EnQuest is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

enerflex.name: Enerflex
enerflex.description: Enerflex Ltd. is a global supplier of products and services to the power generation and gas production industries. The company is headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It serves clients worldwide.

energysolutions.name: EnergySolutions
energysolutions.description: EnergySolutions is an American company specializing in processing low level waste. It is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company was formed in 2007 through the acquisition of three nuclear waste disposal companies.

epocrates.name: Epocrates
epocrates.description: epocrates is a mobile medical reference application providing healthcare professionals with clinical information at the point of care. Initially developed in 1998 for Palm Pilot, it assists in drug interactions, medical calculations, diagnosis, and treatment decisions.

equity-one.name: Equity One
equity-one.description: Equity One, Inc. was a real estate investment trust investing in shopping centers across major U.S. cities including New York, Boston, and Los Angeles. As of 2016, it owned 122 properties totaling 12.8 million square feet.

evertz-microsystems.name: Evertz Microsystems
evertz-microsystems.description: Evertz Microsystems Limited is a Canadian multinational company developing software and hardware for the broadcast industry. It designs and markets video and audio infrastructure equipment and solutions for various sectors including television broadcast and telecommunications.

everyday-health.name: Everyday Health
everyday-health.description: Everyday Health is an American online publication focused on health news and information, medically reviewed by physicians and healthcare professionals. Founded in 2002 as Agora Media, it is now a subsidiary of the Everyday Health Group, a division of Ziff Davis, a digital media and internet company.

exco-technologies.name: Exco Technologies
exco-technologies.description: Exco Technologies Limited is a Canadian global designer, developer, and manufacturer of dies, molds, components, assemblies, and consumable equipment for the die-cast, extrusion, and automotive industries. Founded in 1952, it is headquartered in Markham, Ontario, and operates 20 manufacturing locations in 10 countries.

extendicare.name: Extendicare
extendicare.description: Extendicare Inc. is a Canadian for-profit long-term care provider offering housing, care, and related services to seniors. Based in Markham, Ontario, it operates over 100 care facilities under the Extendicare, Esprit Lifestyle, and ParaMed brands with 23,000 employees.

export-development-bank-of-iran.name: Export Development Bank of Iran
export-development-bank-of-iran.description: Export Development Bank of Iran is an Iranian government-owned policy bank that provides financial and conventional banking services to exporters and importers in Iran. It functions as Iran's export-import bank.

endeavor-streaming.name: Endeavor Streaming
endeavor-streaming.description: Endeavor Streaming is a multinational digital video distribution and streaming company. It collaborates with professional sports leagues and entertainment companies to distribute live and on-demand content and offers various business services.

el5-energo.name: EL5-Energo
el5-energo.description: EL5-Energo is a Russian power generation company created from the reorganization of RAO UES. It is registered in Yekaterinburg with headquarters in Moscow, and Lukoil holds a majority stake of 80.49%.

ergis.name: Ergis
ergis.description: Ergis Spółka Akcyjna is a Polish chemical company that processes plastics and manufactures PVC, PET, and PE products. It is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

enel-distribuicao-sao-paulo.name: Enel Distribuição São Paulo
enel-distribuicao-sao-paulo.description: Enel Distribuição São Paulo is a major Brazilian power distributor in the state of São Paulo. It was created from the breakup of the old state-owned power company Eletropaulo, which monopolized electricity distribution in São Paulo from 1981 to 1999.

elysian-airlines.name: Elysian Airlines
elysian-airlines.description: Elysian Airlines is a cargo airline based at Yaoundé Nsimalen International Airport in Cameroon. Founded in January 2006, it had operations in Liberia and Guinea. The airline stopped scheduled operations in 2010 but resumed them in 2015.

enapor.name: ENAPOR
enapor.description: ENAPOR is the Cape Verdean port authority responsible for managing ports, terminals, and port zones in Cape Verde. It is a public limited company fully owned by the State of Cape Verde. Jorge Pimenta Maurício is the current president.

econet-telecom-lesotho.name: Econet Telecom Lesotho
econet-telecom-lesotho.description: Econet Telecom Lesotho (ETL) is a telecommunications company in Lesotho co-owned by Econet Global and the Lesotho government. It is one of the two main wireless service providers in the country, alongside Vodacom Lesotho.

escadrille-nationale-du-niger.name: Escadrille Nationale du Niger
escadrille-nationale-du-niger.description: Escadrille Nationale du Niger is the governmental airline of Niger based at Diori Hamani International Airport in Niamey. It operates as a state-owned airline serving the country.

eko-fm.name: Eko FM
eko-fm.description: Eko FM is a radio station in Lagos, Nigeria, established in 1997. It serves as the sister station to Radio Lagos. The station is part of the Lagos State broadcasting services.

ensure.name: Ensure
ensure.description: Ensure is an American brand that produces nutritional supplements and meal replacements. It is manufactured by Abbott Laboratories. The brand is known for its dietary supplement products.

ecobank-nigeria.name: Ecobank Nigeria
ecobank-nigeria.description: Ecobank Nigeria Limited is a commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It operates within Nigeria providing banking services. The bank is commonly known as Ecobank Nigeria.

ebonylife-tv.name: Ebonylife TV
ebonylife-tv.description: Ebonylife TV is a Nigerian entertainment TV channel owned by Mosunmola Abudu. Launched on DSTV in 2013, it later moved to StarTimes network in 2018 to improve homegrown content accessibility across Africa.

east-african-development-bank.name: East African Development Bank
east-african-development-bank.description: The East African Development Bank (EADB) is a regional development finance institution located in Kampala, Uganda. It promotes development in East African Community member countries including Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, and Tanzania, and has been operating since its charter was developed after its initiation in 1967.

embassy-of-france-kampala.name: Embassy of France, Kampala
embassy-of-france-kampala.description: The Embassy of France in Uganda is the diplomatic mission of France located in Kampala, Uganda's capital. Since 2022, its ambassador has been Xavier Sticker.

eagle-air.name: Eagle Air
eagle-air.description: Eagle Air is an airline based in Kampala, Uganda, operating regional scheduled services and charter flights across East and Central Africa. Its main base is Entebbe International Airport, with a second hub at Arua Airport in Northern Uganda.

environmental-foundation-for-africa.name: Environmental Foundation for Africa
environmental-foundation-for-africa.description: The Environmental Foundation for Africa (EFA) is a non-governmental organization focused on protecting and restoring the environment in West Africa through community-led programs. Founded in 1992 in the UK as the Environmental Foundation for Sierra Leone, it operates locally in Sierra Leone and Liberia and is registered as a charity in England and Wales.

expresso-telecom.name: Expresso Telecom
expresso-telecom.description: Expresso Telecom is an African telecommunications company operating in Mauritania, Senegal, and Sudan. It plays a key role in the Africa Coast to Europe submarine cable project and is 75% owned by Sudatel.

east-african-safari-air.name: East African Safari Air
east-african-safari-air.description: East African Safari Air was a Kenyan airline whose international operations were suspended in 2004. It maintained regional and domestic services through its subsidiary East African Safari Air Express, which was purchased and rebranded as Fly SAX in 2010.

eastafrican-com.name: Eastafrican.com
eastafrican-com.description: Eastafrican.com, formerly East African Safari Air and Fly-SAX, is a Kenyan airline based at Wilson Airport in Nairobi. It was rebranded after being purchased by the parent company of Fly540.

ethiopian-red-cross-society.name: Ethiopian Red Cross Society
ethiopian-red-cross-society.description: The Ethiopian Red Cross Society is a humanitarian organization partnering with the Ethiopian government and international Red Cross and Red Crescent bodies. It has millions of fee-paying members and over 500,000 volunteers working in relief efforts.

ethiopian-airlines.name: Ethiopian Airlines
ethiopian-airlines.hq: Addis Ababa Bole International Airport, Ethiopia
ethiopian-airlines.description: Ethiopian Airlines is the flag carrier of Ethiopia, wholly owned by the government. Founded in 1945, it began operations in 1946 and expanded to international flights in 1951. The airline became a share company in 1965 and changed its name to Ethiopian Airlines.

enterprise-insurance.name: Enterprise Insurance
enterprise-insurance.description: Enterprise Group Plc is a Ghanaian insurance company incorporated in 2008. It serves as the parent company for its subsidiaries in the insurance sector. The company operates within Ghana's financial services industry.

eco-warriors-movement.name: Eco Warriors Movement
eco-warriors-movement.description: Eco Warrior Movement is a Ghanaian non-governmental organization focused on climate change and environmental sustainability. Founded in 2020 by environmental scientist Otuo-Akyampong Boakye, it works with youth to restore degraded landscapes and mitigate climate change through an inclusive approach.

editora-abril.name: Editora Abril
editora-abril.description: Editora Abril is a major Brazilian publisher and printing company founded in 1950 by Victor Civita in São Paulo. It is one of the largest media holdings in Latin America and is part of Grupo Abril. The company operates in the mass media industry.

extra-mercado.name: Extra Mercado
extra-mercado.description: Extra Hipermercados, known as Extra, is a Brazilian hypermarket and supermarket chain owned by Grupo Pão de Açúcar.

easy-taxi.name: Easy Taxi
easy-taxi.description: Easy Taxi was a mobile app founded in Brazil in 2011 for taxi hailing, available in 30 countries. It allowed users to book and track taxis in real time and later became part of Cabify under Maxi Mobility group.

elo.name: Elo
elo.description: Elo is a Brazilian national financial services corporation headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo. Founded in 2011, it was created by a holding company formed by Banco Bradesco, Banco do Brasil, and Caixa Econômica Federal.

emgepron.name: EMGEPRON
emgepron.description: EMGEPRON is a Brazilian state-owned company linked to the Ministry of Defence through the Navy Command. It manages naval projects and commercializes Brazilian naval defense products and services.

estaleiro-atlantico-sul.name: Estaleiro Atlântico Sul
estaleiro-atlantico-sul.description: Estaleiro Atlântico Sul (EAS) is a Brazilian shipbuilding company founded in 2005 by Samsung Heavy Industries and Brazilian construction groups. Located in Suape port, Pernambuco, it features a large dry dock and uses shipbuilding technology supplied by Samsung.

estaleiro-maua.name: Estaleiro Mauá
estaleiro-maua.description: Mauá Shipyard SA is the oldest private Brazilian shipyard, originally founded as Estabelecimento de Fundição e Estaleiros da Ponta d'Areia. It was acquired in 1846 by Irineu Evangelista de Sousa, the Baron of Mauá.

editora-globo.name: Editora Globo
editora-globo.description: Editora Globo S.A. is a Brazilian publishing house owned by Fundação Roberto Marinho. It began as a bookstore called Livraria do Globo, founded in Porto Alegre in December 1883. The company operates in the publishing sector.

empresa-cubana-de-aeropuertos-y-servicio.name: Empresa Cubana de Aeropuertos y Servicios Aeroportuarios
empresa-cubana-de-aeropuertos-y-servicio.legal_name: Empresa Cubana de Aeropuertos y Servicios Aeroportuarios
empresa-cubana-de-aeropuertos-y-servicio.description: Empresa Cubana de Aeropuertos y Servicios Aeronáuticos S.A. (ECASA) is a government-owned company operating 22 airports in Cuba, including José Martí International Airport in Havana. It manages airport operations across the country.

etecsa.name: ETECSA
etecsa.description: Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Cuba S.A. (ETECSA) is the Cuban state company providing telephony and communications services. It holds a communications state monopoly and serves 8.2 million clients, both national and foreign.

enca.name: eNCA
enca.description: eNCA, also known as eNews Channel Africa, is a South African 24-hour television news broadcaster owned by Cape Town-based e.tv. Launched in June 2008, the channel focuses on African stories and events. It operates as a television news service within South Africa.

exxaro.name: Exxaro
exxaro.description: Exxaro Resources Limited is a South African diversified resources company that primarily produces coal. It operates within the mining industry and is based in South Africa.

entertainment-monitoring-africa.name: Entertainment Monitoring Africa
entertainment-monitoring-africa.description: Entertainment Monitoring Africa (EMA) gathers and publishes airplay music charts in South Africa. It is part of the Times Media Group and provides weekly top 10 and top 100 airplay charts online.

egoli-air.name: Egoli Air
egoli-air.description: Egoli Air was an airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa, operating charter flights domestically and throughout Africa. Its main base was OR Tambo International Airport.

exclusive-books.name: Exclusive Books
exclusive-books.description: Exclusive Books is one of South Africa's largest bookselling chains with stores throughout South Africa, as well as locations in Botswana and Namibia. It operates in the retail bookselling industry.

eskom.name: Eskom
eskom.description: Eskom Hld SOC Ltd is a South African state-owned electricity public utility established in 1923 as the Electricity Supply Commission. It represents South Africa in the Southern African Power Pool.

embassy-of-france-pretoria.name: Embassy of France, Pretoria
embassy-of-france-pretoria.description: The French embassy in South Africa, Lesotho, and Malawi is the main diplomatic mission of France in South Africa. It is located at 250 Melk Street in Pretoria. David Martinon was appointed French Ambassador to these countries in 2023.

echorouk-group.name: Echorouk Group
echorouk-group.description: Echourouk Group SA is an Algerian media company headquartered in Algiers. It operates generalist, information, and sports channels, including Echorouk TV, Echorouk News TV, and CBC Benna, a channel focused on women and cooking.

etrag.name: Etrag
etrag.description: Etrag, short for Entreprise Publique Economique des Tracteurs Agricoles, is an Algerian company specializing in the development of agricultural machinery. It was created on June 29, 2009, following the split of the EPE CMT. The company focuses on agricultural equipment manufacturing.

enmtp.name: ENMTP
enmtp.description: ENMTP is an Algerian state-owned company specializing in the development, manufacture, and distribution of machinery used in public works. It is fully owned by the Algerian government.

embassy-of-france-algiers.name: Embassy of France, Algiers
embassy-of-france-algiers.description: The Embassy of France in Algiers is France's diplomatic mission to Algeria. Since Algeria's independence in 1962, its Chancery has been located in the Peltzer Park neighborhood of Hydra, a suburb of Algiers.

europactor-algeria.name: Europactor Algeria
europactor-algeria.description: Europactor Algeria Spa. is a manufacturer of compaction heavy equipment based in Algeria. It is a partnership between the Spanish firm Europactor S.L. and the Algerian Sofare Spa., a subsidiary of the ENMTP Group.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Easy Hogar y Construcción is a South American chain of home centers founded by Chilean conglomerate Cencosud. It operates in Argentina, Chile, and Colombia, providing home improvement products and services.

enaer.name: ENAER
enaer.description: ENAER is a Chilean aircraft manufacturer. The company operates in the aerospace industry, producing aircraft in Chile.

empresa-nacional-del-petroleo.name: Empresa Nacional del Petróleo
empresa-nacional-del-petroleo.description: Empresa Nacional del Petróleo is a state-owned Chilean company based in Las Condes. It is involved in exploration, production, refining, and marketing of hydrocarbons and their derivatives.

empresas-cmpc.name: Empresas CMPC
empresas-cmpc.description: Empresas CMPC S.A. is a Chilean pulp and paper company headquartered in Santiago. It is the largest paper manufacturer in Chile and one of the biggest worldwide according to Forbes Global 2000 in 2023.

energia-argentina.name: Energía Argentina
energia-argentina.description: Energía Argentina Sociedad Anónima (ENARSA) is a state-owned company in Argentina engaged in petroleum and natural gas exploitation. It also produces, industrializes, transports, and trades petroleum, natural gas, and electricity. The company operates within the petroleum industry.

el-nueve.name: El Nueve
el-nueve.description: El Nueve is an Argentine free-to-air television network based in Buenos Aires. It focuses on general entertainment programming. The channel is known by its brand name El Nueve.

estudios-san-miguel.name: Estudios San Miguel
estudios-san-miguel.description: Estudios San Miguel was an Argentine film studio active in the 1940s and early 1950s, based in Buenos Aires. It was a major studio during the Golden Age of Argentine cinema, producing award-winning films like La guerra gaucha and Juvenilia. The studio ceased production after 1952 due to financial overextension.

edesur.name: Edesur
edesur.description: Edesur is an electricity distribution company headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It operates as a public utility within the country.

entel.name: ENTel
entel.description: Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (ENTel) was an Argentine state-owned enterprise that held the monopoly on public telecommunications in Argentina.

editorial-ivrea.name: Editorial Ivrea
editorial-ivrea.description: Editorial Ivrea is an Argentine publisher specializing in manga and comics, operating in Argentina, Chile, Finland, and Spain. It also published Lazer, a magazine focused on anime and related media, which ended publication in 2009 due to copyright issues.

el-comercio-group.name: El Comercio Group
el-comercio-group.description: El Comercio Group is a Peruvian media conglomerate owning multiple newspapers and television stations. It is the largest media conglomerate in Peru and one of the largest in South America. The group is owned by the Miró Quesada family.

empresa-nacional-de-ferrocarriles-del-pe.name: Empresa Nacional de Ferrocarriles del Peru
empresa-nacional-de-ferrocarriles-del-pe.legal_name: Empresa Nacional de Ferrocarriles del Peru
empresa-nacional-de-ferrocarriles-del-pe.description: Empresa Nacional de Ferrocarriles del Perú (Enafer) is a public company managing the railway network of Peru. It ensures the management and commercial use of the country's railways.
