embassy-of-france-lima.name: Embassy of France, Lima
embassy-of-france-lima.description: The Embassy of France in Peru is the permanent diplomatic mission of France located at 3415 Arequipa Avenue, San Isidro District, Lima.

empresas-polar.name: Empresas Polar
empresas-polar.description: Empresas Polar is a Venezuelan corporation founded in 1941 in Caracas, originally as a brewery known as La Polar. It is the largest brewery in Venezuela and has diversified into food processing and packaging, also serving markets abroad.

ediciones-ekare.name: Ediciones Ekare
ediciones-ekare.description: Ediciones Ekare is a Venezuelan children's book publisher based in Caracas. Founded in 1978, it aims to publish books reflecting Venezuelan and Latin American culture. The publisher's catalog includes original works and translations, supporting reading promotion through the Banco del Libro organization.

empresas-1bc.name: Empresas 1BC
empresas-1bc.description: Empresas 1BC is a privately owned Venezuelan media corporation headquartered in Caracas. It operates various media enterprises including Radio Caracas Televisión and Radio Caracas Radio. The conglomerate is headed by Marcel Granier.

ecua-andino-hats.name: Ecua-Andino Hats
ecua-andino-hats.description: Ecua-Andino Hats is an Ecuadorian company that produces and exports Panama hats. It was founded in 1985 by Alejandro Lecaro and Édgar Sánchez. The company specializes in fashion accessories from Ecuador.

ep-petroecuador.name: EP Petroecuador
ep-petroecuador.description: EP Petroecuador is the national oil company of Ecuador and a significant part of the country's economy. Ecuador is a member of OPEC and produced 531,000 barrels of crude oil per day in 2019. The company is involved in producing refined petroleum products and the government relies heavily on energy sector revenues.

escobar-inc.name: Escobar Inc
escobar-inc.description: Escobar Inc is a company registered in Puerto Rico associated with scams involving branded smartphones and flamethrowers. It was established in 2015 and linked to Roberto de Jesús Escobar Gaviria.

entel-bolivia.name: Entel Bolivia
entel-bolivia.description: Entel S.A. is a major Bolivian state-owned telecommunications company headquartered in La Paz, Bolivia.

ecojet.name: EcoJet
ecojet.hq: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia
ecojet.description: Línea Aérea EcoJet S.A. is a Bolivian domestic airline headquartered in Santa Cruz de la Sierra. It began scheduled passenger operations in 2013, linking Cochabamba with nine major domestic destinations and competing with the state-owned Boliviana de Aviación.

effa-motors.name: Effa Motors
effa-motors.description: Effa Motors is a Uruguayan automobile and commercial vehicle manufacturer headquartered in San José de Mayo. Founded in 2006 by Eduardo Effa, it constructs vehicles imported as CKD kits. Effa Motors is a subsidiary of the Aler Group.

easysky.name: EasySky
easysky.description: EasySky was a low-cost airline based in Honduras with its head office in Tegucigalpa. Since 2015, its main operational base was Toncontín International Airport in Tegucigalpa.

efg-holding.name: EFG Holding
efg-holding.description: EFG Holding S.A.E. is an Egyptian financial services company operating in the Middle East, North Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa, and South Asia. It specializes in securities brokerage, asset management, investment banking, private equity, and other financial services. The company serves a diverse client base including sovereign wealth funds and high-net-worth individuals.

egyptian-television-network.name: Egyptian Television Network
egyptian-television-network.description: The Egyptian Television Network is a television service run by the National Media Authority in Egypt. It began programming on 21 July 1960 and currently operates more than fifteen national channels along with several satellite broadcast channels.

egyptian-german-automotive-company.name: Egyptian German Automotive Company
egyptian-german-automotive-company.description: The Egyptian German Automotive Company (EGA) is an Egyptian car assembler located in 6th of October City, Cairo. Founded in 1996 as a joint venture to assemble Mercedes-Benz vehicles, it is managed by Daimler AG.

ezz-steel.name: Ezz Steel
ezz-steel.description: Ezz Steel is the largest steel company in Egypt, the Middle East, and North Africa. Headquartered in Cairo, it produces about 7 million metric tons of steel annually and operates four steel plants in Alexandria, Sadat City, Suez, and 10th of Ramadan City.

egyptian-media-production-city.name: Egyptian Media Production City
egyptian-media-production-city.description: Egyptian Media Production City Co SAE (EMPC) is an information and media complex located in 6th of October City, Giza Governorate, Egypt. It is listed on the Egyptian Exchange, with most shares owned by the Government of Egypt through the National Media Authority and other state-owned enterprises. The complex covers about 35 million square meters.

egyptian-commission-for-rights-and-freed.name: Egyptian Commission for Rights and Freedoms
egyptian-commission-for-rights-and-freed.legal_name: Egyptian Commission for Rights and Freedoms
egyptian-commission-for-rights-and-freed.description: The Egyptian Commission for Rights and Freedoms (ECRF) is a human rights organisation based in Cairo, Egypt. It reports on human rights abuses and coordinates campaigns for victims of torture and disappearance. The organisation operates despite continuous harassment by Egyptian authorities.

egyptian-general-petroleum-corporation.name: Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation
egyptian-general-petroleum-corporation.description: The Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) is Egypt's national oil company. Its operations include crude oil exploration, refining, storage, lubricant and grease production, and services for oil and gas projects.

egyptian-natural-gas-company.name: Egyptian Natural Gas Company
egyptian-natural-gas-company.description: Egyptian Natural Gas Company (GASCO) is a subsidiary of the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company. Established in 1997, it operates natural gas transmission, distribution, and processing, managing a gas grid extending 22,000 kilometers and connected to neighboring countries via the Arab Gas Pipeline.

egyptian-natural-gas-holding-company.name: Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company
egyptian-natural-gas-holding-company.description: The Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (EGAS) is a state-owned holding company in Egypt. Established in 2001, it owns and manages state stakes in gas projects and issues natural gas exploration licenses.

egyptair.name: EgyptAir
egyptair.description: EgyptAir is the state-owned flag carrier of Egypt headquartered at Cairo International Airport. It operates scheduled passenger and freight services to 84 international and nine domestic destinations across 56 countries. EgyptAir is a member of Star Alliance and the only carrier in the MENA region to belong to this alliance.

egyptair-cargo.name: EgyptAir Cargo
egyptair-cargo.description: Egyptair Cargo is the cargo division of EgyptAir, the Egyptian national airline. It operates using dedicated cargo aircraft and the cargo capacity of its sister passenger airline. Its main base is Cairo International Airport.

embassy-of-france-bamako.name: Embassy of France, Bamako
embassy-of-france-bamako.description: The Embassy of France in Bamako is France's diplomatic mission to Mali, located in the capital city. In 2022, the French ambassador was expelled by Mali for diplomatic reasons.

edicoes-novembro.name: Edições Novembro
edicoes-novembro.description: Edições Novembro E.P. is the state-owned newspaper publishing company of Angola.

embassy-of-france-tunis.name: Embassy of France, Tunis
embassy-of-france-tunis.description: The Embassy of France in Tunis is France's diplomatic mission to Tunisia. It operates in the foreign affairs sector and represents French interests in Tunisia. The embassy is located in Tunis.

express-air-cargo.name: Express Air Cargo
express-air-cargo.description: Express Air Cargo is an airline based in Tunis, Tunisia, founded in 2015. It operates within the airline industry, providing air cargo services. The company is part of Tunisia's aviation sector.

elektra.name: Elektra
elektra.description: Elektra is a Mexican retail chain founded in 1950 and part of Grupo Elektra. It operates nearly 1,300 locations across Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras. The company sells household appliances, electronics, mobile phones, motorcycles, furniture, toys, and offers money transfer services.

el-palacio-de-hierro.name: El Palacio de Hierro
el-palacio-de-hierro.description: El Palacio de Hierro is a Mexican upscale department store chain headquartered in Mexico City. As of 2025, it operates multiple department stores and freestanding stores for international brands. It is operated by Grupo Palacio de Hierro, part of Grupo BAL.

expansion.name: Expansión
expansion.description: Expansión is a Spanish-language business news magazine targeting markets in Mexico and Latin America. Created in 1969 and redesigned in 1999, it focuses on the people and ideas driving Mexico's private sector, distinguishing itself from other media that emphasize macroeconomic and political topics.

estafeta-carga-aerea.name: Estafeta Carga Aérea
estafeta-carga-aerea.description: Estafeta Carga Aérea is a Mexican cargo airline based in Mexico City. It operates domestic cargo charters in Mexico and the US, with over 25 interline agreements connecting to the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its main base is Ponciano Arriaga International Airport in San Luis Potosí.

equaflight.name: Equaflight
equaflight.description: Equaflight is an airline based in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo, operating scheduled and charter flights from Pointe Noire Airport. Founded in 1998, it is a subsidiary of Regourd Aviation and is banned from entering the European Union since 2009.

ecuato-guineana.name: Ecuato Guineana
ecuato-guineana.description: Ecuato Guineana de Aviación (EGA) was Equatorial Guinea's national airline, established in 1986. It operated passenger and cargo services in West Africa from Malabo International Airport. The airline now appears to be defunct.

eritel.name: EriTel
eritel.description: EriTel, officially the Eritrean Telecommunication Services Corporation, is the sole operator of landline and mobile telephone services in Eritrea. It is one of several internet service providers in the country.

eritrean-airlines.name: Eritrean Airlines
eritrean-airlines.description: Eritrean Airlines is the national airline of Eritrea, based at Asmara International Airport and wholly owned by the government. It has been banned from flying into the European Union since December 2012 and is operationally defunct as of September 2024.
